summary: Prepare KDA decode with the packed projection output stride
compatibility: B12X KDA decode accepts MXFP8 projections whose packed output has alignment padding; logical gate widths and head offsets remain unchanged.
details: Decode preparation derives the beta row stride from finalized packed MXFP8 weights after loading.
The 8598-column GLM TP3 projection retains its logical slices while its beta view advances by 8600 storage columns.
